capture.command: sudo -n python3 -u leanos/scripts/capture-hardware.py --manifest evidence/qotom-hardware-manifest.json --image leanos/build/boot/leanos-0.1.0-x86_64.iso --elf leanos/build/boot/leanos.elf --device /dev/serial/by-id/usb-FTDI_FT232R_USB_UART_<redacted>-if00-port0 --output evidence/qotom-boot-attempt-03 --timeout 180

operator: Repository owner at physical Qotom; assistant issued SSH reboot and serial capture

provenance.note: Imported without changing raw or event bytes from the pre-integration capture script archived at implementation.py in this observation bundle. Reset time comes from the SSH shutdown log. Duration is original quiet_seconds plus last event elapsed_seconds. Original result contains a local adapter path and is retained privately; inventory metadata is sanitized, not raw serial data. The recorded command and device path redact the adapter serial only; paths name the original workspace and archived capture implementation.
